neighbours.label: The plural noun 'changes' (and 'Changes') in the pattern 'changes in X'
fire: Temperature rises are likely to be accompanied by dramatic changes in precipitation in many regions.
First, changes in family composition and social norms may lead to bad outcomes in old age.
The release of water can cause sudden changes in temperature and in the quality of the river.
Changes in the output levels of manufacturing and mining were published in the annual table.
Moths are so sensitive to changes in their habitats that they make good indicator species.
A sealed bottle is not affected by changes in pressure and has fewer chances for leaks.
The report describes recent changes to the tax code and their effect on small businesses.
Small changes in diet can make a surprising difference to blood pressure within weeks.
